services.title: Emergency Plumbing

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing

about_pullquote: I started this to be the plumber I'd want in my own home.
about_para_1: Fielding Gas Services has been serving Preston families and businesses for over 12 years. We're Gas Safe Registered and handle everything from emergency call-outs to planned installations. Our founder built the business on a simple belief: turn up on time, do the job right, charge a fair price.
about_para_2: We're known in Preston for honest advice and work that lasts. Most of our customers come back to us, or recommend us to neighbours, because we don't oversell jobs or rush through repairs. You get a plumber who listens and solves the real problem, not the most expensive one.
reviews_heading: What Preston Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a burst pipe at 11pm on a Tuesday. Fielding answered straight away, got here by midnight, and had the leak stopped and cleaned up within an hour. Fair price for an emergency call too. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Mark D.

reviews.text: Boiler completely failed just before Christmas. Thought we'd be freezing, but Dave diagnosed it same afternoon and fitted a new one the next day. Installation was tidy, no mess left behind. Heating's been perfect since.
reviews.author: Jennifer T.

reviews.text: Doesn't try to sell you work you don't need. Called for a leaking tap and he arrived, fixed it, explained what was wrong, and didn't fob us off with unnecessary repairs. Professional and honest. Recommended him to three neighbours already.
reviews.author: Paul H.
